items.title: Classical Geometric Islamic Starburst CNC Pattern
items.description: Download this premium, production-ready vector design featuring a high-density repeating hexagonal starburst motif, a staple of classical geometric Islamic art. Fully optimized as a cutting template in scaled DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, it guarantees clean, precise execution on CNC routers, laser cutters, and plasma cutting machines. Ideal for fabricators creating highly symmetrical screens for privacy partitions, decorative wall art, and custom cabinetry inserts requiring traditional elegance.
